currentCard.prompt: Как меняется давление воздуха в лёгких при спокойном вдохе?

answers.note: При выдохе давление в лёгких становится выше атмосферного, и воздух выходит наружу.
Воздух движется по градиенту давления из области более высокого давления в область более низкого.
Когда поток воздуха прекращается, давление в альвеолах выравнивается с атмосферным.
Внутриплевральное давление ниже внутриальвеолярного, а не наоборот.

currentCard.explanation: При спокойном вдохе внутрилёгочное давление становится ниже атмосферного. Воздух движется из области более высокого давления в область более низкого, поэтому входит в лёгкие.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: 22.3 The Process of Breathing

literal.prompt: Как меняется давление воздуха в лёгких при спокойном вдохе?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L70–L71 explain expansion and decreased intra-alveolar pressure below atmospheric driving inspiration; L67 gives the ordering atmospheric > alveolar > pleural. Above atmosphere belongs to expiration (L68/L73); equality is the no-flow equilibration condition (L51–L52), not an unchanged pressure during active inspiration; below intrapleural reverses the physiological ordering (L53/L67). Therefore key1 is unique under the ordinary quiet inspiration specified. All four are comparable full-sentence pressure comparisons.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: При спокойном вдохе внутрилёгочное давление становится ниже атмосферного. Воздух движется из области более высокого давления в область более низкого, поэтому входит в лёгкие.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The first sentence reproduces the inspiration pressure relation in L71. The second supplies the direction of flow from high to low pressure in L67 and applies it to atmospheric air entering lungs. Two sentences directly express the correct below-atmosphere answer without conflating intrapleural with alveolar pressure.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: При выдохе давление в лёгких становится выше атмосферного, и воздух выходит наружу.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L68 and L73 explicitly say intrapulmonary pressure rises above atmospheric on expiration and this gradient drives air out. The note teaches the above-atmosphere option in its correct phase; it does not assert that phase occurs during quiet inspiration.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Воздух движется по градиенту давления из области более высокого давления в область более низкого.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L67 defines air flowing down a pressure gradient from higher to lower pressure. This is a concrete law explaining the selected lower-pressure option, adding flow direction to the prompt/key’s static comparison; it is not an unrelated atmospheric fact.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Когда поток воздуха прекращается, давление в альвеолах выравнивается с атмосферным.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L51 says communicating alveoli equalize with atmosphere; L52 says pressure equalizes but does not remain equal throughout the cycle. Combined with L63 flow=pressure difference/resistance and L67, stopped flow corresponds to equality in normal open-airway breathing. This own-option note explains the equality boundary instead of incorrectly making it persist throughout inspiration.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Внутриплевральное давление ниже внутриальвеолярного, а не наоборот.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L53 explicitly puts intrapleural pressure below intra-alveolar, and L67 restates alveolar pressure greater than pleural during inward airflow. The note provides the positive correct ordering of its two named pressure compartments, then corrects the offered reversal. It is not just an empty “wrong answer” label.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Как меняется давление воздуха в лёгких при спокойном вдохе?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: При выдохе давление в лёгких становится выше атмосферного, и воздух выходит наружу.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: The pronoun «Оно» agrees with neuter «давление» and the full sentence answers how it changes. Its length and form match the other pressure comparisons.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Above-atmosphere pressure is a genuine respiratory phase relation, so confusing expiration with inspiration is plausible.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L68/L73 assign above-atmosphere pressure to outward expiration. During quiet inspiration L71 instead requires below-atmosphere pressure. This alternative is false for the asked phase.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note names expiration explicitly and correctly teaches why air then exits; both pressure and flow direction are supported for this option itself.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Как меняется давление воздуха в лёгких при спокойном вдохе?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Воздух движется по градиенту давления из области более высокого давления в область более низкого.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Оно становится ниже атмосферного» is a complete, correctly agreed answer to «Как меняется давление…?» with the same syntax as the competing claims.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: The below-atmosphere relation must be recognised against the opposite phase, equilibration and a different pressure compartment; no answer-length clue selects it.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L71 expressly states increased lung volume produces intra-alveolar pressure lower than atmospheric and drives air in. L74 establishes quiet breathing context, and L67 maintains alveolar pressure above pleural, so exactly key1 matches.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The high-to-low pressure-gradient direction at L67 adds a useful own-answer mechanism: a lower lung pressure causes atmospheric air to enter. Prompt/key name only a pressure comparison and do not state the direction law. Overlap with explanation is permitted.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Как меняется давление воздуха в лёгких при спокойном вдохе?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Когда поток воздуха прекращается, давление в альвеолах выравнивается с атмосферным.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Оно остаётся равным атмосферному» is grammatical; adjective case after «остаётся» is correctly instrumental and refers to the same pressure.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Because alveoli communicate with atmosphere and equalize at pauses, an uninformed player can reasonably confuse boundary equilibrium with the flowing inspiration phase.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L51–L52 explicitly distinguish equilibration from remaining equal. L71 requires a transient pressure decrease to create inspiratory flow, excluding “остаётся равным” as a description of that change.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note correctly locates equality at cessation of flow; L51–L52 and the pressure-flow relation L63/L67 support this normal open-airway interpretation. Quiet spontaneous breathing in the prompt supplies scope; occluded-airway pathology is not asserted.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Как меняется давление воздуха в лёгких при спокойном вдохе?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Внутриплевральное давление ниже внутриальвеолярного, а не наоборот.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: The full sentence keeps pressure as the same neuter pronoun and correctly uses comparative «ниже» with «внутриплеврального». The term is longer but is a genuine alternate comparator, not a marker of the key.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Intrapleural pressure is a real ventilation pressure named alongside alveolar and atmospheric pressures, creating a credible compartment-ordering confusion.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L53 states pleural pressure is below alveolar, and L67 specifically orders atmospheric > alveolar > pleural in inspiration. Thus lung-air pressure does not become below intrapleural; only key1 supplies the correct comparison.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note teaches the actual pleural-versus-alveolar ordering for this offered comparator. It contains a concrete positive own-option fact before its brief correction «а не наоборот», as supported by L53/L67.

absoluteLevel.individualGround: Anatomy/physiology familiarity makes the subatmospheric alveolar pressure during quiet inspiration recognisable. General adults may know air enters lungs but may confuse whether pressure rises, equals atmosphere, or how it relates to pleural pressure. This is thematic pressure-mechanics knowledge, not an obscure quantitative professional detail. The four plausible comparison statements support MEDIUM; knowing only the everyday act of breathing does not uniquely select the answer.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Air moves along a pressure gradient from an area of higher pressure to an area of lower pressure.
correctNoteExtraFact.beyondPromptAndKey: The asked fact and key compare lung pressure to atmosphere during inspiration; they do not state this directional flow law. The note supplies the physical mechanism meaningful specifically to the lower-pressure correct answer. Its reuse in the explanation is allowed.
